criterion: Delta_drop_pipeline < Delta_drop_baseline, where Delta_drop = F1_in_domain - F1_external

interpretation.as_written: Delta_drop_pipeline < Delta_drop_baseline holds only on IDRiD, and by 0.45pp — an order of magnitude below the CI width. On Messidor-2 the sign reverses. The claim 'the pipeline is more resistant to clinical degradation' is NOT supported.
interpretation.absolute_performance: External weighted F1 is significantly higher for the pipeline on BOTH sets (+0.0700, p=0.0021 and +0.0510, p=0.0138).
interpretation.why_they_disagree: Delta_drop is measured from each arm's own in-domain level, and the pipeline's is 6.55pp higher, so the metric systematically penalizes the stronger arm. Relative degradation is in fact near-identical: 16.8% vs 17.2% on Messidor-2.
interpretation.defensible_claim: The pipeline does not reduce the proportional drop under domain shift, but it performs better at every point, external clinical sets included.
interpretation.methodological_note: Delta_drop is not a neutral robustness measure when the two arms have different baseline levels. Relative degradation (Delta_drop / in-domain) or absolute external performance are the sounder comparisons.

caveats: Evaluated from fold-0 checkpoints; no between-fold variance.
The same two datasets appear in Experiment 6 as the camera groups kowa_idrid and topcon_messidor2 — the numbers are identical.
